$comment: Migrations that exist on disk but are deliberately NOT in _journal.json,
and are therefore never applied by packages/schemas/migrate.ts.
Every entry here is technical debt with a deadline, not a permanent state.
All nine below were discovered by the 2026-08-26 platform audit
listed so scripts/check-migration-journal.mjs can keep NEW drift from
appearing while these are worked through.
Applying them requires verifying real production state first — see
ledger tables as partitioned tables and moves data; it needs a maintenance
window and a validated backup, not a routine deploy.

unapplied.reason: Partitions assessment_control_events and audit_logs and migrates existing rows. Destructive, non-idempotent, needs a maintenance window.
Index only. Safe to apply once the journal is reconciled.
Enum widening on existing columns. Verify no rows hold values outside the new enum before applying.
Creates TPRA tables. TPRA routes may already be failing in production because these do not exist — verify before assuming.

53 RLS policies. Made idempotent (DROP POLICY IF EXISTS) and hardened with FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY + WITH CHECK on 2026-08-26. Apply only after confirming the application does NOT connect as a role that needs to bypass RLS for background jobs.

ADR-002 append-only triggers. Made idempotent (DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS) on 2026-08-26. Blocked on M-02: the data-retention purge deletes assessments, which these triggers will reject. Settle that conflict first.
Enum widening on soa_items. Same precondition as 0051.
Requires the pg_partman extension and the partitioning groundwork from 0049.
